svg.title: Choose corrections from source evidence
svg.desc: 1. Verify source grid and physical calibration: Unknown units: block physical correction and promotion; 2. Verify solar, views and terrain as required: Missing or placeholder metadata cannot establish support; 3. If BRDF requested: evaluate model support: Unsupported/invalid: block; do not silently substitute identity; 4. Explicit omission: record NOT_REQUESTED: Omission is not BRDF normalization or physical approval; 5. Review topographic gains and masks: Software execution does not certify scientific validity; 6. Validate spectra and intended application: Independent targets, directions and polygon/spatial groups
